agentic_sub_queries: 蘋果在大中華區最近賣得好不好？
records.answer:
蘋果在大中華區最近賣得非常好，營收出現強勁反彈，最近三個季度均錄得兩位數甚至高達38%的同比增長。

以下是各季度具體數據與驅動因素：

**2026會計年度第二季（截至2026年3月28日）：** 大中華區營收從去年同期的160.02億美元成長至204.97億美元，增幅達28%，主要受惠於iPhone銷量增加，且人民幣相對美元走強也帶來了有利影響 [AAPL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #65]。新聞報導也指出大中華區這個被所有人看淡的板塊增長了28% [AAPL_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #2]。

**2026會計年度第一季（截至2025年12月27日）：** 大中華區營收從去年同期的185.13億美元成長至255.26億美元，增幅高達38% [AAPL_10Q_202512.html, chunk #53]。

**2025會計年度全年對比：** 值得注意的是，大中華區在2025會計年度全年營收為643.77億美元，較2024年的669.52億美元下降了4%，主要原因是iPhone銷量下降，部分被Mac銷量增加所抵消 [AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #155]。這表明最近幾個季度的強勁反彈扭轉了此前的下滑趨勢。

- Siri AI 將能從用戶的各個應用程式中提取上下文資訊，例如用戶可以詢問姊姊透過簡訊推薦的某個播客名稱，Siri 能直接呈現內容，無需開啟任何獨立的應用程式或服務 [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。
- 軟體工程資深副總裁 Craig Federighi 強調，Siri AI 的目標是讓 Siri 從一個「 glorified kitchen timer」（ glorified 廚房計時器）轉變為「AI 時代的數位助手」 [AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0]。
- 新版 Siri 將更加個人化，並且 Apple 特別強調安全與隱私保護方面 [AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2]。

agentic_sub_queries: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過 Windows 作為核心平台，帶動用戶增加與 Microsoft Edge、Bing、Copilot、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Consumer 及 Xbox Game Pass 等服務的互動，進而推動其雲端業務成長 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。

**Windows 作為雲端與服務的引擎**

Microsoft 在 10-K 中明確表示，其策略是「利用 Windows 來推動雲端業務、擴大 PC 市場佔有率，並提升用戶對 Microsoft Edge、Bing、Copilot、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Consumer、Xbox Game Pass 等服務的參與度」[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。這顯示 Windows 作業系統不僅是產品本身，更是引導用戶進入 Microsoft 各項雲端與 AI 服務的入口。

**Copilot 與搜尋廣告的整合**

在搜尋與新聞廣告業務方面，Microsoft 將 Copilot 定位為一款旨在提供資訊、娛樂與啟發的「數位夥伴」（digital companion）[MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。Microsoft Edge 瀏覽器與搭載 Copilot 的 Bing 搜尋引擎被視為帶動用戶獲取與參與度的關鍵工具 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。

**裝置與 Copilot+ PCs**

在裝置方面，Microsoft 設計並銷售包括 Surface（含 Copilot+ PCs）在內的裝置，這些裝置的設計目的是讓人們與組織能透過 Windows 及整合的 Microsoft 產品與服務，連結到對他們最重要的人與內容 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。

**Microsoft 365 Consumer 與 Windows 裝置的關聯**

Microsoft 365 Consumer 的營收受到消費者購買新裝置時一併購買 Office 的比例影響，同時也受到從地端授權的 Office 轉向 Microsoft 365 Consumer 訂閱的趨勢所驅動 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。此外，Microsoft 365 Consumer 雲端營收也受到 Outlook.com 與 OneDrive 的通訊與儲存需求影響，而這些需求主要來自訂閱與廣告 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**Microsoft 365 Commercial 與 Copilot**

在商務端，Microsoft 365 Commercial 是一個 AI 驅動的商務與生產力解決方案平台，整合了 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Enterprise Mobility + Security [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。在 Microsoft 的商業指標定義中，Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud 的營收成長指標明確包含 Microsoft 365 Copilot [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #103] [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #101]。

**整體雲端業務的規模經濟**

Microsoft 的雲端業務受益於三種規模經濟：以顯著較低的單位成本部署運算資源的資料中心、協調與聚合多元客戶需求的資料中心以提升資源利用率，以及降低應用程式維護勞動成本的多租戶架構 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。Microsoft Cloud 提供跨技術堆疊的整合，同時提供開放性、縮短實現價值的時間、降低成本並提升敏捷性 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。

**近期的整體財務表現**

就整體財務表現而言，Microsoft 在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三個月中，營收為 828.86 億美元，較去年同期成長 18%；營業利益為 383.98 億美元，成長 20% [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #101]。在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的三個月中，營收為 812.73 億美元，較去年同期成長 17%；營業利益為 382.75 億美元，成長 21% [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #103]。

Nature of Operations

Google was incorporated in California in September 1998 and re-incorporated in the State of Delaware in August 2003. Basis of Consolidation

The consolidated financial statements of Alphabet include the accounts of Alphabet and entities consolidated under the variable interest and voting models. Intercompany balances and transactions have been eliminated. Use of Estimates

Preparation of consolidated financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires us to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported and disclosed in the financial statements and the accompanying notes. Actual results could differ materially from these estimates due to uncertainties. On an ongoing basis, we evaluate our estimates, including those related to the allowance for credit losses; contingent liabilities; fair values of financial instruments and goodwill; income taxes; inventory; and useful lives of property and equipment, among others. We base our estimates on assumptions, both historical and forward looking, that are believed to be reasonable, and the results of which form the basis for making judgments about the carrying values of assets and liabilities. Revenue Recognition

Revenues are recognized when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to our customers, and the collectibility of an amount that we expect in exchange for those goods or services is probable. Sales and other similar taxes are excluded from revenues. Google Advertising

Google advertising revenues consist of revenues from:

•Google Search and other properties, including revenues from traffic generated by search distribution partners who use Google.com as their default search in browsers, toolbars, etc. and other Google owned and operated properties like Gmail, Google Maps, and Google Play;

•YouTube properties; and

•Google Network properties, including revenues from Google Network properties participating in AdMob, AdSense, and Google Ad Manager. Our customers generally purchase advertising inventory through Google Ads, Google Ad Manager, Google Display & Video 360, and Google Marketing Platform, among others. We offer advertising by delivering both performance and brand advertising. We recognize revenues for performance advertising when a user engages with the advertisement. For brand advertising, we recognize revenues when the ad is displayed, or a user views the ad. For ads placed on Google Network properties, we evaluate whether we are the principal (i.e., report revenues on a gross basis) or agent (i.e., report revenues on a net basis). Generally, we report advertising revenues for ads placed on Google Network properties on a gross basis, that is, the amounts billed to our customers are recorded as revenues, and amounts paid to Google Network partners are recorded as cost of revenues. Where we are the principal, we control the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers. Our control is evidenced by our sole ability to monetize the advertising inventory before it is transferred to our customers and is further supported by us being primarily responsible to our customers and having a level of discretion in establishing pricing. Google Subscriptions, Platforms, and Devices
